# Align Dental Care

> Align Dental Care is a premier dental clinic in Sri Lanka offering comprehensive cosmetic, orthodontic, and implant dentistry services with advanced digital smile design technology.

Based in Colombo with multiple locations across Sri Lanka including Dehiwala and Piliyandala, Align Dental Care is led by Chief Dentist Dr. Nasar Abdul Wadood and maintains ISO 9001:2015 quality standards. The clinic specializes in Invisalign treatments, digital smile design, and transformative cosmetic dentistry.
